form.label: Azure AD sign-in anomalies
form.description: Frothly Azure AD sign-in review: foreign geo-IP logins, source addresses, and failed-sign-in spread across accounts.

search.query: index=* sourcetype=ms:aad:signin loginStatus=Success | stats count by location.country | sort -count

panel.title: Foreign (non US/CA) sign-ins by account and IP

search.query: index=* sourcetype=ms:aad:signin loginStatus=Success NOT (location.country=US OR location.country=CA) | stats count by userPrincipalName, ipAddress, location.country | sort -count
index=* sourcetype=ms:aad:signin loginStatus=Failure | stats count by userPrincipalName, ipAddress | sort -count
